newsitem.title: USA: Daiwa Bank agrees to pay $60,000 CBOT fine.
newsitem.headline: Daiwa Bank agrees to pay $60,000 CBOT fine.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade said Tuesday that Daiwa Bank Ltd, a former member firm, had agreed to pay a fine to settle charges of violating exchange rules.
Without admitting or denying any violation, Daiwa agreed to pay the exchange $60,000. The CBOT said the offer of settlement was submitted by the bank.

The CBOT charged Daiwa with executing exchange of futures for physicals transactions in which the quantities of U.S. Treasury bond and five-year Treasury note futures exchanged for their underlying cash securities were not equivalent.
The CBOT also alleged that Daiwa had failed to ensure compliance with the Regulations of the Association by its employees.
